artifact_role: pre-registered portfolio accounting and allocation template contract
evidence_status: exploratory reused-history test; not untouched OOS

hypothesis.source: Phase A selected exploratory hypothesis after an 81-comparison search
hypothesis.claim_under_test: A coarse equity-over-duration override during the frozen V6.6 Reflation regime improves portfolio-level risk-adjusted outcomes relative to the same neutral allocation held statically.

rebalance.scheduled: first common trading day of each calendar month
rebalance.event_driven: also rebalance when the one-bar-lagged target template changes between neutral and Reflation
rebalance.weights_between_rebalances: self-financing drift with adjusted close-to-close asset returns

transaction_cost.cost_application: deduct turnover * bps / 10000 from portfolio value on each rebalance date

causal_inverse_volatility.volatility_estimate: sample standard deviation of daily adjusted close-to-close returns through t-1
causal_inverse_volatility.rebalance: first common trading day of each calendar month

comparison_window.common_start: first date on or after 2007-01-04 for which the 63-row lagged inverse-volatility benchmark is finite for all three assets

interpretation_guardrails: No Phase B parameter may be changed after viewing portfolio results in order to rescue performance.
A negative result is valid and ends the Reflation-only test without adding assets or tuning the override magnitude.
Because the Reflation hypothesis was selected from Phase A reused history, favorable Phase B results remain exploratory and cannot be called untouched OOS confirmation.
A Stagflation gold override, if studied later, must be registered as a separate incremental experiment and must not be retroactively included in this primary result.
